description:
Search historical federal grant awards on USAspending.gov to see who has been funded, by whom, and how much. Useful for competitive research: find peer organizations funded for a topic, typical award sizes, and which agencies fund an area.

Examples:
  - "Who got funded for rural diabetes programs in FY2024?" -> keyword="rural diabetes", fiscal_year_start=2024, fiscal_year_end=2024
  - "What has Navajo Nation received?" -> recipient="Navajo Nation"
Results are sorted by award amount, largest first.

keyword.description: Topic text matched against award descriptions

recipient.description: Recipient name search, e.g. 'University of Michigan'

response_format.description: 'markdown' for readable text, 'json' for structured data

name: grants_search_past_awards
title: Search Past Federal Awards
